name: Hans-Dieter Ziegler
bio:
Hans-Dieter Ziegler's career began not on the track, but in the meticulous world of organizational psychology. After graduating from the University of Munich, he specialized in talent acquisition and employee relations within the automotive industry. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, Hans-Dieter saw an opportunity to combine his professional expertise with his personal passion when a position opened at Red Bull Racing.

His approach to HR is deeply rooted in pragmatism. He believes in fostering a supportive yet performance-driven environment where every team member understands their role and contributes effectively. Hans-Dieter is known for his ability to identify and nurture talent, ensuring Red Bull Racing remains at the forefront of innovation and competitive excellence. What sets him apart is his direct, no-nonsense communication style, ensuring clarity and efficiency in all HR-related matters.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: A man of average height with a slightly receding hairline, Hans-Dieter exudes an air of competence and reliability.

quirks: Always carries a meticulously organized planner.
Insists on holding team meetings precisely at 14:14 (2:14 PM).
Has a collection of miniature F1 cars on his desk, each representing a Red Bull Racing victory.
